stories.story_fr: La fiabilité des installations en amont s’est améliorée à 95,7 %, contre 95,4 % au T4 2025.
stories.story_en: Upstream plant reliability improved to 95.7%, up from 95.4% in Q4 2025.

stories.story_fr: La disponibilité de raffinage a atteint 96,3 %, dépassant l’objectif de 96 %.
stories.story_en: Refining availability rose to 96.3%, surpassing the 96% target.
stories.quote: refining availability improved to 96.3% (4Q25 96.0%) and above our target of 96% availability.

stories.story_fr: BP a annoncé un accord pour vendre la raffinerie de Gelsenkirchen, augmentant l’objectif de réduction des coûts structurels de 1 milliard de dollars.
stories.story_en: BP announced an agreement to sell the Gelsenkirchen refinery, boosting the structural cost reduction target by $1 billion.
stories.quote: announced agreement to sell Gelsenkirchen refinery. ... structural cost reduction target will increase by $1 billion to $6.5‑7.5 billion by 2027.

stories.story_fr: Le bénéfice sous-jacent RC s’est élevé à 3,2 milliards de dollars et le flux de trésorerie opérationnel à 2,9 milliards de dollars, malgré une hausse du fonds de roulement ajusté de 6 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: Underlying RC profit reached $3.2 billion and operating cash flow $2.9 billion, despite a $6 billion adjusted working capital build.
stories.quote: underlying RC profit $3.2 billion; operating cash flow $2.9 billion after taking into account a $6.0 billion adjusted working capital build
